summary: Backend /api/ai/suggest 7/7 pytest pass (real Claude call, id filtering, keeper exclusion, bytes sum, 400 empty, 422 invalid). minor.issue: free_bytes/total_bytes typed int; any fractional value from client -> 422 int_from_float. Consider Optional[float] or coercing.

ui_bugs.issue: FastAPI 422 detail is an array; api.ts throws Error(body.detail) -> UI shows '[object Object]'. Stringify/handle array detail.
Demo mode success says 'files removed from your phone' (misleading in demo); also '1 files' plural

integration_issues.issue: FIXED by testing agent: DEMO_DISK.free = 9.6*1024*MB was fractional (10307921510.4) -> backend 422. Rounded with Math.round in src/demo.ts.

issues: textTransform capitalize on meta renders '1y Ago', 'Recommended To Keep' – odd casing
Checkbox at top:-4/right:-4 gets clipped on the last thumbnail in horizontal row

action_items: api.ts: handle array `detail` (422) so error text is readable instead of '[object Object]'; also Math.round free/total bytes before sending
Backend: accept float or coerce free_bytes/total_bytes to int
Fix '1 files' pluralization (AI card, review success) and demo-mode success wording
Increase review remove button touch target to 44px

scanner.duplicateKeys: fallback key `${w}x${h}:${kind}` when MD5 is skipped (files >300MB, >1500 hashes, or digest error) treats any same-size files as duplicates (folder files are all 0x0:file) -> risk of flagging non-duplicates for deletion. Mark such matches as 'possible' or exclude them.
critical_code_review_comments: scanner.ts duplicateKeys fallback hash is not content-based: same-size large videos (>300MB, never hashed) or unhashable files get grouped as duplicates – safety risk for a delete tool
api.ts error parsing assumes string detail

success_rate.frontend: 95% (AI flow failed before demo.ts fix; all flows pass after)

rca_of_issue: AI helper '[object Object]': demo DEMO_DISK.free=9.6*1024*MB is non-integer -> pydantic v2 rejects int field (int_from_float) -> 422 with list detail -> api.ts Error(list) -> '[object Object]'. Mitigated via Math.round in demo.ts; real-device disk ints unaffected.
